message.content: **What I did and why:** I checked the broker's market summary and quote for BA — it was trading at $155.70 (bid $155.68 / ask $155.72) in a quiet session with ~41.2M shares traded and no pending corporate actions — and confirmed the account holds $75,000 cash with a 50-share MSFT position and no BA exposure. Because the mandate permits BA purchases up to $25,000 per order and $50,000 total today, and the price was stable and near the market, I placed a single buy limit order for 100 shares at $155.80 (≈$15,580, about 20.8% of cash, well inside both the per-order and daily caps, and no money moved out of the account); it filled at $155.80. The reported figures I relied on in the order were BA's FY2023 10-K results (filed 2024-01-31): revenue of $77,794M, net loss of $2,222M, diluted EPS of –$3.67, and operating cash flow of $5,960M — a large revenue base and positive operating cash generation that support a modest, sized-down position despite continued GAAP losses. I did not touch MSFT, and I made no sales, consistent with the buy-only restriction.
